hypothesis: Replacing the old Boolean mouth bag with a welded quad annulus will improve the neutral seam and deformation.
visualFailures: The neutral lip seam becomes a uniform horizontal slit with weak Cupid bow and unnatural corners.
The linear skin-to-lip bridge flattens the nasolabial area and produces visible fan-like creases.
The projected boundary has 14 angular backtracks and cannot be connected by the current radial correspondence without folded surfaces.
Open and smile preserve the folded bridge; all variants have perioral triangle self-intersections.
Hair-to-body negative distances are introduced, despite retained original control-point coordinates matching within 0.000359 mm.

fileIntegrity.note: The 90 existing boundary edges belong to the two eye apertures. These integrity checks do not make the candidates collision-safe.

decision: Reject all three candidates. Preserve the r0001 baseline and retain r0003 only as research evidence.
